lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat sukh hoi sagale dookh jaahi ||2||
lines.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, happiness comes, and all sorrows and pains simply vanish. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: akul nira(n)jan purakh agam apaareeai ||
lines.translation: He is without relatives, immaculate, all-powerful, unapproachable and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sacho sachaa sach sach nihaareeai ||
lines.translation: Truly, the True Lord is seen to be the Truest of the True.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਧਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR na jaapai kichh teree dhaareeai ||
lines.translation: Nothing established by You appears to be false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhasai de daataar jet upaareeai ||
lines.translation: The Great Giver gives sustenance to all those He has created.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਤੁ ਸੂਤਿ ਪਰੋਇ ਜੋਤਿ ਸੰਜਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikat soot paroi jot sa(n)jaareeai ||
lines.translation: He has strung all on only one thread; He has infused His Light in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਮੰਝਿ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਤਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukame bhavajal ma(n)jh hukame taareeai ||
lines.translation: By His Will, some drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and by His Will, some are carried across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਗੁ ਮਥਾਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh jeeu tudh dhiaae soi jis bhaag mathaareeai ||
lines.translation: O Dear Lord, he alone meditates on You, upon whose forehead such blessed destiny is inscribed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਲਖੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀਐ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: teree gat mit lakhee na jaai hau tudh balihaareeai ||1||
lines.translation: Your condition and state cannot be known; I am a sacrifice to You. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa too(n) tusahi miharavaan achi(n)t vasahi man maahi ||
lines.translation: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, you automatically come to dwell within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa too(n) tusahi miharavaan nau nidh ghar mahi paahi ||
lines.translation: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I find the nine treasures within the home of my own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa too(n) tusahi miharavaan taa gur kaa ma(n)tr kamaahi ||
lines.translation: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, I act according to the Guru's Instructions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੂੰ ਤੁਸਹਿ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jaa too(n) tusahi miharavaan taa naanak sach samaahi ||1||
lines.translation: When You are pleased, O Merciful Lord, then Nanak is absorbed in the True One. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀ ਬੈਹਨੑਿ ਬੈਹਣੇ ਮੁਚੁ ਵਜਾਇਨਿ ਵਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: kitee baihanhi baihane much vajaain vaj ||
lines.translation: Many sit on thrones, to the sounds of musical instruments.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਰਹੀਆ ਲਜ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak sache naam vin kisai na raheeaa laj ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the True Name, no one's honor is safe. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਨੑਿ ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸਣੁ ਖੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tudh dhiaainhi bed katebaa san khaRe ||
lines.translation: The followers of the Vedas, the Bible and the Koran, standing at Your Door, meditate on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਣਤੀ ਗਣੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ਤੇਰੈ ਦਰਿ ਪੜੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ganatee ganee na jaai terai dar paRe ||
lines.translation: Uncounted are those who fall at Your Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧਿਆਇਨੑਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਇੰਦ੍ਰਾਸਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahame tudh dhiaainhi i(n)dr i(n)draasanaa ||
lines.translation: Brahma meditates on You, as does Indra on his throne.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰ ਬਿਸਨ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਭਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)kar bisan avataar har jas mukh bhanaa ||
lines.translation: Shiva and Vishnu, and their incarnations, chant the Lord's Praise with their mouths,

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰ ਪਿਕਾਬਰ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਅਉਲੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: peer pikaabar sekh masaaik auleee ||
lines.translation: as do the Pirs, the spiritual teachers, the prophets and the Shaykhs, the silent sages and the seers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਉਲੀਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: ot pot nira(n)kaar ghat ghat mauleee ||
lines.translation: Through and through, the Formless Lord is woven into each and every heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ਧਰਮੇ ਤਗੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooRahu kare vinaas dharame tageeai ||
lines.translation: One is destroyed through falsehood; through righteousness, one prospers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੀਐ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jit jit laaihi aap tit tit lageeai ||2||
lines.translation: Whatever the Lord links him to, to that he is linked. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚੰਗਿਆਈਁ ਆਲਕੁ ਕਰੇ ਬੁਰਿਆਈਁ ਹੋਇ ਸੇਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: cha(n)giaaee(n) aalak kare buriaaee(n) hoi ser ||
lines.translation: He is reluctant to do good, but eager to practice evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅਜੁ ਕਲਿ ਆਵਸੀ ਗਾਫਲ ਫਾਹੀ ਪੇਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aj kal aavasee gaaphal phaahee per ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, today or tomorrow, the feet of the careless fool shall fall into the trap. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੀਆ ਕੁਢੰਗ ਗੁਝਾ ਥੀਐ ਨ ਹਿਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiteeaa kudha(n)g gujhaa theeai na hit ||
lines.translation: No matter how evil my ways are, still, Your Love for me is not concealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਢਕਿਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਤੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tai sahi dhakiaa man mahi sachaa mit ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak: You, O Lord, conceal my short-comings and dwell within my mind; You are my true friend. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੁਝੈ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਗੋਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau maagau tujhai daiaal kar daasaa goliaa ||
lines.translation: I beg of You, O Merciful Lord: please, make me the slave of Your slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਰਾਜੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਬੋਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh paaee raaj jeevaa boliaa ||
lines.translation: I obtain the nine treasures and royalty; chanting Your Name, I live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦਾਸਾ ਘਰਿ ਘਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan daasaa ghar ghanaa ||
lines.translation: The great ambrosial treasure, the Nectar of the Naam, is in the home of the Lord's slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin kai sa(n)g nihaal sravanee jas sunaa ||
lines.translation: In their company, I am in ecstasy, listening to Your Praises with my ears.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਮਾਵਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kamaavaa tin kee kaar sareer pavit hoi ||
lines.translation: Serving them, my body is purified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਖਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਪੀਸਿ ਬਿਗਸਾ ਪੈਰ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pakhaa paanee pees bigasaa pair dhoi ||
lines.translation: I wave the fans over them, and carry water for them; I grind the corn for them, and washing their feet, I am over-joyed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਹੁ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapahu kachhoo na hoi prabh nadar nihaaleeai ||
lines.translation: By myself, I can do nothing; O God, bless me with Your Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦਿਚੈ ਥਾਉ ਸੰਤ ਧਰਮ ਸਾਲੀਐ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mohi niragun dichai thaau sa(n)t dharam saaleeai ||3||
lines.translation: I am worthless - please, bless me with a seat in the place of worship of the Saints. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਹਾ ਸਦ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan tere charan kee hoi rahaa sad dhoor ||
lines.translation: O Friend, I pray that I may remain forever the dust of Your Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀਆ ਪੇਖਉ ਸਦਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran tuhaareeaa pekhau sadaa hajoor ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak has entered Your Sanctuary, and beholds You ever-present. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਅਸੰਖ ਹੋਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit puneet asa(n)kh hohi har charanee man laag ||
lines.translation: Countless sinners become pure, by fixing their minds on the Feet of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath naam prabh jis naanak masatak bhaag ||2||
lines.translation: The Name of God is the sixty-eight holy places of pilgrimage, O Nanak, for one who has such destiny written upon his forehead. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਜਪੀਐ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨਾਉ ਪਰਵਦਿਗਾਰ ਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit japeeai saas giraas naau paravadigaar daa ||
lines.translation: With every breath and morsel of food, chant the Name of the Lord, the Cherisher.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰੇ ਰਹੰਮ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kare raha(n)m tis na visaaradaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord does not forget one upon whom He has bestowed His Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਵਣਹਾਰ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਾਰਦਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap upaavanahaar aape hee maaradaa ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself destroys.
